data.narrative:
BurnBot is a Series A climate and energy technology company founded by Anukool Lakhina and Waleed 'Lee' Haddad. The company operates within a sector comprising one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. BurnBot has raised $25M to date.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement. Using the $25M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying this multiplier yields an implied valuation of $50M. Peer-median analysis is not applicable; while eight same-sector companies exist, none meet minimum qualifying criteria (≥3 datapoints) when filtered for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier. A broad sector median would introduce unwarranted noise given the narrow peer overlap in stage and scale.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $42M to $57M, with a median of $50M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier for BurnBot's specific risk profile and market dynamics within the climate and energy sector, as well as the absence of direct peer trading or financing comparables at identical stage and scale. Additional financing data or operational metrics would improve precision.
